title: Order Shipment Flow
interaction_flow: alt userType == null: ShipmentServlet → Admin: redirect login.jsp (Access Denied)
OrderServiceImpl → DB: UPDATE orders SET shipped=1 WHERE orderid=? AND prodid=? AND shipped=0
alt k > 0: status = 'Order Has been shipped successfully!!' else: status = 'FAILURE'
alt status == 'FAILURE': ShipmentServlet → Admin: forward to unshippedItems.jsp
UserServiceImpl → DB: SELECT fname FROM users WHERE username=?
ShipmentServlet → MailMessage: orderShipped(userName, firstName, orderId, amount)
ShipmentServlet → Admin: forward to shippedItems.jsp + JS status message
key_relationships: OrderServiceImpl uses DBUtil.provideConnection() for DB access
MailMessage delegates to JavaMailUtil.sendMail(...) [static, protected overload]
JavaMailUtil uses jakarta.mail Session + Transport for SMTP delivery

method_signatures.ShipmentServlet.doGet: doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws ServletException, IOException
method_signatures.OrderServiceImpl.shipNow: String shipNow(String orderId, String prodId) — returns 'FAILURE' or success message
method_signatures.MailMessage.orderShipped: static void orderShipped(String recipientEmail, String name, String transId, double transAmount)
method_signatures.JavaMailUtil.sendMail_overload: protected static void sendMail(String recipient, String subject, String htmlTextMessage) throws MessagingException

conditional_logic: Guard: if session 'usertype' is null → redirect to login, abort flow
Branch on shipNow() result: 'FAILURE' → forward unshippedItems.jsp, skip email; else → send email + forward shippedItems.jsp

data_objects.OrderDetails: Bean: orderId, prodId, qty, amount, shipped (int 0/1), time, prodName, prodImage
data_objects.DB table 'orders': columns: orderid, prodid, quantity, amount, shipped (0=unshipped, 1=shipped)

important_notes: ShipmentServlet is @WebServlet('/ShipmentServlet'), handles both GET and POST (doPost delegates to doGet). Email subject for shipped order: 'Hurray!!, Your Order has been Shipped from Ellison Electronics'. JavaMailUtil reads credentials from ResourceBundle 'application' (mailer.email, mailer.password). UserServiceImpl.getFName is called only on success path to personalise the email.
